Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: New: share presets with a one-line code - Share on any preset to copy it, and the Import button to paste one in. New: /pfp apply <name> posts a preset straight from a macro, plus /pfp list. The refresh interval is now any number of minutes (double-click it) and you can set a 'stop after N hours' limit. Fixed: presets now remember their duty by id, so a renamed duty can no longer post the wrong listing.
